texts.value: Membrane-associated scaffold protein that participates in multiple cellular processes, including oxidative stress-induced survival signaling, RNA trafficking and translational regulation, and the modulation of membrane signaling through its interaction with RNA-binding proteins and lipid raft-associated domains (PubMed:19015244). Functions as a regulator of activation of several intracellular kinases, including SRC, FAK, and PI3K, following oxidative stress (PubMed:19015244). Promotes RNA splicing and stability of lipogenic enzymes (PubMed:37595559). Mechanistically, recruits the lipogenic transcription factor SREBP1 at active promoters, thereby bridging the newly transcribed lipogenic genes from RNA polymerase II to the SRSF1 and U1-70K-containing RNA-splicing machinery (PubMed:37595559). Associates with key proteins of the NLRP3 inflammasome pathway and subsequently inhibits NLRP3 inflammasome activation (PubMed:40250624). Sequesters a subset of AGO2-bound mRNAs from miRNA-mediated silencing by binding to poly(G)-rich motifs in their 3'-UTR independently of the AGO2 binding site, likely by preventing recruitment of miRISC effectors (By similarity)

Interacts with PURA (By similarity). Interacts with SRC family protein kinases YES1, SRC and FYN (PubMed:19015244). Upon tyrosine phosphorylation, interacts with PIK3R1 (PubMed:19015244). Interacts with IGF2BP1/IMP-1 in an RNA-dependent manner (PubMed:19015244). Interacts with ASC (PubMed:40250624). Interacts with NLRP3 (PubMed:40250624). Interacts with SRSF1 (PubMed:37595559). Interacts with AGO2 (By similarity)
Translocates from the cytosol to plasma membrane after UV irradiation
Widely expressed (PubMed:14585507). In gastric mucosa, detected in the bottom region of the foveolar epithelium (at protein level) (PubMed:19015244)
Arg-982 is dimethylated, probably to asymmetric dimethylarginine
Phosphorylated on tyrosine by SRC family protein kinases upon oxidative stress, for instance following UV irradiation
May play a role in the progression of scirrhous-type gastric cancer by supporting cancer cell survival during oxidative stress
Belongs to the constitutive coactivator of PPAR-gamma family
